current_influence: The numeric locator selects which retrieved record receives an assessment.
quarantine_rule: Validation requires exact input-index coverage, rejects duplicates, and resolves cited evidence against the claimed source record before any decision is accepted.
removal_gate: Use an opaque deterministic record reference with explicit locator provenance instead of an agent-authored number.

current_influence: The numeric locator chooses which draft receives the agent-authored review categories.
quarantine_rule: Not quarantined; missing indexes fall back, but duplicate or permuted valid indexes can misassociate reviews.
removal_gate: Use opaque draft references and require exact one-to-one validated coverage before applying reviews.

current_influence: The execution schema accepts an agent-authored run confidence.
quarantine_rule: Not quarantined at the model boundary.
removal_gate: Execution schema omits confidence and derives compatibility values from registered categories.

current_influence: The model-authored value can affect relation handling through compatibility paths.
quarantine_rule: Not quarantined at every relation consumer.
removal_gate: Relation output uses atomic support, grounding, mapping, and speculation categories only.

current_influence: The model authors a count that should be computed from cited document IDs.
quarantine_rule: Not quarantined; no deterministic recomputation is mandatory yet.
removal_gate: Compute the count from unique validated document locators and reject model-authored counts.

current_influence: The model-authored value remains in rejected-candidate artifacts.
quarantine_rule: Not proven quarantined from review ordering and diagnostics.
removal_gate: Rejected candidates expose categorical rejection reasons without confidence.

current_influence: A model-authored confidence remains accepted before normalization.
quarantine_rule: Not quarantined at the execution boundary.
removal_gate: Execution schema omits confidence and routing consumes registered categories.

current_influence: The model-authored value can be converted into a support band.
quarantine_rule: Not quarantined because a numeric-to-category adapter remains.
removal_gate: Remove numeric-to-category conversion and require direct categorical findings.

current_influence: The score can influence ordering and generate a support category.
quarantine_rule: Not quarantined from ranking or category conversion.
removal_gate: Rank from deterministic policy over categorical findings and remove model relevance.

current_influence: The model-authored run confidence remains in the execution contract.
quarantine_rule: Not quarantined at the model boundary.
removal_gate: Execution output omits confidence and uses categorical assessments only.

current_influence: Untyped numeric anchor values lack an origin-specific provenance envelope.
removal_gate: Numeric anchors use a typed source-measurement envelope with span and source hash.

current_influence: Untyped numeric metadata can enter staged entity data.
removal_gate: Remove arbitrary numeric metadata or require a typed origin envelope.

current_influence: Scientific numbers can be staged without complete source-measurement provenance.
removal_gate: Every numeric observation includes source locator, literal span, unit, method, and source hash.

current_influence: Untyped numbers remain in rejected-fact payloads.
quarantine_rule: Not proven isolated from retry or review behavior.
removal_gate: Rejected numeric values use typed provenance or remain literal text only.

current_influence: Untyped numeric source anchors can affect entity linking.
removal_gate: Numeric source anchors use typed provenance and validated identifier semantics.

current_influence: Untyped numeric target anchors can affect entity linking.
removal_gate: Numeric target anchors use typed provenance and validated identifier semantics.

current_influence: The model authors a composite low/medium/high expected-value judgment.
removal_gate: Replace the band with atomic observable findings and derive value posture deterministically.

current_influence: The model authors a composite low/medium/high risk judgment.
removal_gate: Replace the band with atomic risk findings and deterministic veto policy.
